title: COLUMN spills a horizontal array for multi-column ranges, #SPILL! on whole-row ranges off column A, and rejects non-reference constants at entry (0x800A03EC)
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, COLUMN([reference]) without an argument returns the calling cell's 1-based column (COLUMN() at Sheet1!H10 -> 8, at XFD1048576 -> 16384). For a multi-column single-area reference it returns a horizontal array of column numbers (COLUMN(B2:D4) -> {2,3,4}), which produces #SPILL! when a whole-row reference such as COLUMN(3:5) is placed past column A (at H10). A multi-area reference returns #REF!, a runtime non-reference returns #VALUE!, and literal constants/arrays are rejected at formula entry (0x800A03EC). All 3,080 full-bank COLUMN rows match.
basis: Measured across all 36 COLUMN cases in CalcFunc-Evidence readings/cell-context/reference-info.json, DnaCalc cfunc_m3_6, and crates/calc-fml/tests/fixtures/entry/excel-entry.tsv; 3,080/3,080 full-bank rows match.
